## The Business Challenge

Suppose you work as an analyst at the **Australian Treasury**. 
You have been asked to put together a dataset that describes how the Australian economy has changed over time.

You are interested in three measures: life expectancy, population, and GDP per capita. 
The World Bank collects each of these measures and makes them available through its API.

For this analysis, we want observations from **1960 to 2020**, measured every **five years**. 
We could download the data by hand, but that would mean repeatedly finding and downloading the same kinds of data for different years and indicators.

Instead, we will use the World Bank API to request the data directly. 
We will start with one indicator in one year, then build up our code until we can collect all three indicators across the full period.

By the end of the tutorial, we will have created a dataset that we can use to study how Australia has changed between 1960 and 2020.

### Libraries

We will need the following libraries:

```{r}
library(httr2)
library(tidyverse)
```
